description: Cite-chance score for one page, 0 to 100. Use this when the user asks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google AI Overviews are likely to cite a page, or how to fix that. Pass exactly one of url, html, text, or sample. Returns the score and a fix list ordered by the biggest point gain. The checks cover an answer in the opening, question headings, an FAQ block, structured data, lists and tables, heading order, short sentences, a number with a source, a recent date, and an author line. Pasted html and text are scored as given and are not fetched. A url is one public page, with robots.txt respected. It does not call an AI engine and it does not promise a citation. Do not use it for private or local addresses, rankings, or traffic.

html.description: Pasted HTML of one page. Scored as given. Nothing is fetched.

sample.description: Score a built-in example page. Use this when the caller has no page yet.

text.description: Pasted plain text or Markdown. Scored as given. Nothing is fetched.

url.description: One public page address. A bare domain means https. Do not pass this together with html or text.

name: score_page_citation

gain.description: Points still available if this check is fixed.

fixes.description: Fixes that still raise the score, largest gain first.

score.description: 0 to 100. The sum of points earned.

title: Score one page for citation chance
